citations.narrative:
The facility has not documented its annual review of their contingency plan. While facility representatives believe they
conducted the review during their February 2026 IACUC meeting, the last date notated in their records was November
29th, 2024. The facility was unable to provide any alternative records to support the annual review being conducted since
this date. Reviewing the outlined plan in place helps ensure the facility has assessed the current plan for any needed
amendments to better prepare for unexpected disasters or events, as well as a detailed strategy to address instructions
for, but not limited to animal evacuation, sheltering-in-place, backup provisions for husbandry and food/watering supplies,
and veterinary care. Contingency plans, as well as all annual review documentation, must be made available upon
request for USDA inspections.
The facility corrected during the inspection.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representatives.
